head: Tiny Planet: sleep sounds app for iPhone you turn with a finger
dek: Tiny Planet is a sleep and focus sounds app where you spin a small planet to move between nature sounds such as waves, rain, birdsong and thunder, which blend as you travel. It came out on November 26 for $3.99 and was #17 among paid Health & Fitness apps on the US App Store on 27 November.
details: It works offline and has a sleep timer of 15, 30 or 60 minutes, controls on the lock screen, and it pauses when headphones are unplugged. The listing says there's no account, no ads, no tracking and no subscription. It's made by Simon Herzog and needs iOS 17 or later on iPhone or iPad.
where: iPhone and iPad (iOS 17 or later), App Store, $3.99 one-time
means: If you fall asleep or focus better with nature sounds, this is a one-time purchase with no subscription or ads.
todo: Search "Tiny Planet: Sleep & Focus" in the App Store; it has no ratings yet, so look at the screenshots before buying.
thumb_words: SPIN A PLANET, HEAR THE RAIN
